description: One clause of an object's law, as world-object answers it in `laws`: the fragment of FOUNDATION section 2 that judges every write.

main.description: Record key: `<object>/<clause name>`. A law clause is state on the object, not content-named; the record carries no cid of its own.

pin.description: The pin of the package the object runs.

reading.description: The package's public text about the clause (`law NAME "reading": EXPR`); a refusal by it says `refused NAME: reading`.
